dataset.text: The central bank raised interest rates by 25 basis points to combat inflation.
Astronomers detected high-energy gamma-ray bursts originating from a distant neutron star.
Quarterly semiconductor revenue surged due to accelerated enterprise AI chip demand.
Quantum computer processors demonstrated fault-tolerant surface code error correction.
The plaintiff asserts breach of contract under Section 45 regarding fiduciary duty.
Pursuant to the non-disclosure agreement, confidential intellectual property was compromised.
The appellate court affirmed the summary judgment in favor of the defendant.
Statutory compliance mandates strict adherence to antitrust regulations and disclosures.
The arbitration clause requires dispute settlement under international commercial arbitration rules.
Patient presented with acute myocardial infarction and elevated troponin biomarkers.
Histopathological examination confirmed benign follicular adenoma in the thyroid gland.
Prescribed intravenous cephalosporin antibiotic regimen to treat bacterial meningitis.
Contrast-enhanced MRI revealed no signs of cerebral edema or ischemic stroke.
Cardiopulmonary bypass was maintained during open-heart coronary artery graft surgery.
